description: This file defines the Java class ModifyFeatureDefinitionResponse, which models the response to a modify feature definition command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and accessing details about the response, such as feature ID, associated thing ID, definition created, and status code.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a modify feature definition command, providing details such as the feature ID, associated thing ID, definition created, and HTTP status. Includes factory methods for instantiation based on status or JSON parsing.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating that a feature definition was created, returning HTTP 201 Created status.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating that a feature definition was modified, returning HTTP 204 No Content status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to construct a ModifyFeatureDefinitionResponse instance.
